name: sitting side reach stretch
description: Seated, reaching over to the side stretches your lats and obliques. It is easy on the hips and good for desk breaks.
instructions: Sit tall with your legs crossed or your feet flat and place one hand on the floor beside you.
Reach your other arm up and over your head toward the side, lengthening along your flank.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
